stemMd: What did the restoration tests reveal?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Some files had not copied correctly.

options.label: B
options.textMd: All possible future losses had been eliminated.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Every original photograph had already been destroyed.

options.label: E
options.textMd: The two original drives were in different countries.

explanationMd: The tests found copying failures that the existence of a drive alone had not revealed. This showed the value of checking actual recovery rather than assuming a backup is complete and usable.

distractorRationale.d: No such loss of all originals is reported.
distractorRationale.e: They were initially in the same cupboard.
distractorRationale.b: The archive explicitly avoided that promise.
